detection_capability_statement: On Apple M2 (Darwin 27.0.0), unmodified ML-KEM-512 decaps (2382.3 us median, IQR 16.3 us) reliably detects injected secret-dependent delays >= 2 us (Spearman rho_binary >= +0.1022, acc 54.10%, p < 1/201 (0.0050)); rolling-median detrending (W=51) lowers/matches threshold to >= 2 us (Spearman rho_binary >= +0.1069, acc 55.40%, p < 1/201 (0.0050)).
